info.name: AuthKit API
info.description:
Runnable contract suite for every endpoint: the success path and every error path (validation, authentication, not found, conflicts, payload limits).

Run it with `npm run test:api` against the docker-compose stack started with raised rate limits (`RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE=1000 AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE=1000 docker compose up -d`, the collection sends more auth requests than the default 10 per minute) after `docker compose exec app npm run db:seed`. Before the run, the runner signs the access tokens (valid, expired, another audience, unknown user), seeds refresh tokens for the seeded user (id=1, "Loro") straight into the database, generates the oversized upload, and sets the working directory to `docs/api`, where the fixtures live.

Every response is checked for an `X-Request-Id`, and every error for the `{ error, requestId }` shape (collection-level test). Requests run in order: the refresh, logout and picture requests share state.

Not covered here: a successful Facebook login, which needs a real Facebook token (covered by the route tests, with Facebook stubbed), and responses that need the server to fail (5xx, 409 races), covered by the route and PostgreSQL tests.

exec: pm.test('error body is exactly { error, requestId }', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json()).sort()).to.eql(['error', 'requestId']))

item.name: Health
Basic health check

exec: pm.test('body has exactly environment, memory, status, timestamp, uptime, version', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json()).sort()).to.eql(["environment", "memory", "status", "timestamp", "uptime", "version"]))
pm.test('memory is reported in MB', () => { const { memory } = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(memory.used).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(memory.total).to.be.at.least(memory.used) })

item.name: Detailed health check (open outside production)

exec: pm.test('body has exactly checks, environment, status, timestamp, uptime, version', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json()).sort()).to.eql(["checks", "environment", "status", "timestamp", "uptime", "version"]))
pm.test('overall status is healthy or degraded', () => pm.expect(['healthy', 'degraded']).to.include(pm.response.json().status))

pm.test('memory and system checks are present', () => { const { memory, system } = pm.response.json().checks; pm.expect(['normal', 'warning', 'critical']).to.include(memory.status); pm.expect(system.nodeVersion).to.match(/^v\d+/) })

item.name: The refreshed access token authorizes the user
Replaying the replaced refreshToken right away (401, concurrent refresh)

request.description: Within the 5 s grace window a replay counts as a concurrent refresh: rejected, but the session survives (next request).

item.name: The session survives a replay within the grace window
Replaying a refreshToken rotated a minute ago (401, theft)

request.description: Past the grace window a replay is treated as theft: the whole session (token family) is revoked.

item.name: Upload again (replaces the picture; the previous object is deleted by the outbox worker)

exec: // The object is deleted by the outbox worker once the change is committed (ADR-0016), so poll for it
const waitUntilGone = (url, done, attemptsLeft) => pm.sendRequest(url, (error, image) => {
if (attemptsLeft === 0) { pm.expect(error === null ? image.code : String(error)).to.eql(404); return done() }
pm.test('previous object is deleted', done => waitUntilGone(previousUrl, done, 30))

item.name: Delete picture (clears it; the stored object is deleted by the outbox worker)

exec: // The object is deleted by the outbox worker once the change is committed (ADR-0016), so poll for it
const waitUntilGone = (url, done, attemptsLeft) => pm.sendRequest(url, (error, image) => {
if (attemptsLeft === 0) { pm.expect(error === null ? image.code : String(error)).to.eql(404); return done() }
pm.test('stored object is deleted', done => waitUntilGone(pm.environment.get('pictureUrl'), done, 30))
